name: 活動日時を添えたチャンネル選択
prompt:
Create the second render of this same single-row Japanese channel selector. V001 places the row in a canvas that is far too tall. Correct the canvas and checkbox placement while preserving all exact text, colors and glyphs.

The entire output image must be the same very wide, short 390x70 strip as the primary native preview (aspect ratio 5.57:1). Do not put a short row inside a taller poster or presentation canvas. Crop the output to the row bounds. The row content itself should occupy approximately y13 through y56, leaving only about 13-14 logical pixels of white above and below, matching native. Do not enlarge the text or channel glyph to compensate for the canvas.

Use these logical positions and sizes on the 390x70 canvas: light-gray outline # at x24 y17, about 23x23; bold dark 「地域からのお知らせ」 at x64 y13 in 14px type; muted-gray 「5日前に活動」 at x24 y44 in 12px type; one 24x24 forest-green rounded selected checkbox at x340 y18, with a small white check. Keep the title and activity line exactly. Move the checkbox farther right than in v001 so its right edge is about 26px from the canvas edge.

Keep only this sparse white row. Do not add divider, card, shadow, additional channels, emoji, speaker icon, badges or extra text. There is no hyperlink in this Japanese native row. Keep the channel label dark because it is a selectable row label, not a hyperlink. If a real hyperlink label appears, linked words must be blue. Do not recolor the green selected checkbox blue.

Use the native preview as exact authority for the crop, positions, text and colors. Use v001 only to preserve the rendering style while removing its excessive top/bottom whitespace and shifting the checkbox right.
reviewNotes: v002を実画像で目視。日本語2行・灰色の#・森林緑の選択チェックを保持し、リンク文言なし。v001と同じ2171x724（比率3.00）の出力で、native390x70（比率5.57）に対して上下余白が依然過大。チェックもnativeより約15px左に残る。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
